records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue decreased by $13.8 million, or 4.4%, during the three months ended January 2, 2021 compared to the same period a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Additionally, NSE has experienced some impact to customer demand including for Field Instruments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: These were partially offset by a decrease in accrued expenses and other current and non-current liabilities of $8.5 million, an increase in accounts receivable of $6.4 million, an increase in inventory of $3.3 million, and a decrease in accounts payable of $2.4 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin decreased by 0.3 percentage points during the three months ended January 2, 2021 from 60.4% in the same period a year ago to 60.1% in the current period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the six months ended January 2, 2021, Cash provided by operating activities was $132.6 million, consisting of net income of $36.2 million adjusted for non-cash charges (e.g., depreciation, amortization and stock-based compensation) which totaled $82.6 million, including changes in deferred tax balances, and changes in operating assets and liabilities that provided $13.8 million.
